responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation-URL mapping companion for the C-family option table. This file associates option spellings from c.opt with manual anchor suffixes, including language-specific overrides where the same switch is documented in GCC, GFortran, or GDC manuals, so generated option metadata and diagnostics can link command-line options to the correct online documentation. It is declarative support data for option/help infrastructure, not the definition of options themselves.
